# mabinogi-010 — establishment log (2026-11-13)

Evans 1907 cols 75 l. 11 – 81 l. 15 (PDF pp. 70–73). Every column read on the page image (zoom 4, three crops per
column; zoom 9–10 for single lines). Base: Evans's letters as on the image; the second witness used only to locate
disagreements and for punctuation and paragraph shape (the pilot's practice). 6-shaped w → w; r-rotunda → r;
ſ → s; raised letters into the line; line-end marks, Evans's dotted underlines (col 75 "emei", "bei" l. 36,
"yn" l. 12, "dodi" l. 13; col 78 "doethwyf"; col 79 "attaf") and the mark over *hut* (col 79 l. 9) dropped.

Tooling note: crops cut with PyMuPDF from the page (p. 70 and p. 72 at x ≈ 92–228 / 212–332; p. 71 and p. 73 at
0–125 / 110–245; text y ≈ 48–385). PyMuPDF had to be installed with `python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages
pymupdf` (plain `pip` installed it for another interpreter).

## Opening and close
- col 75 l. 11 — "Dyuot yr ystauell …" mid-line after "a chyrchu y llys." (009's close; no large initial). Evans
  *ỳ2 ỳſtauell*; divided *y'r* as the witness ('to the chamber').
- Close: col 81 l. 15 "… Ac yuelly y teruyna y geing honn yma o'r Mabinogy." (the Math initial follows).

## Worklist items (18 check + 18 loss), decided on the image
OCR misreadings of Evans's sorts where the witness agrees with the image: col 75 ll. 19 (ti), 24 (ohonunt), 27
(ym kyffes y Duw), 30 (eisswys), 34 (ymyr-rut → ymyrrut); col 76 ll. 6 (y dylyut), 12 (arbe-rth); col 77 ll. 1
(pryf), 9, 11 (gellwng), 13 (nys), 14 (Gwna, Arglwyd), 15, 16 (y ryw), 17 (Ac), 21 (gyweir), 32 (rac), 35
(ollwng); col 78 ll. 10 (Ac; y-ny → yn y), 34 (yr y gymeint; kanys); col 79 ll. 1 (a seith swmer), 10, 15 (a phy
ny bei), 31 (y nos), 32 (eil nos); col 80 ll. 24 (rydha-af), 31.

Raised letters (into the line, as the witness):
- col 75 l. 13 — "ac wrth y llinyn": *y* raised over the line.
- col 77 l. 18 — "yr yscolheic": *h* raised between *l* and *eic*.
- col 78 l. 16 — "Duw a rodo y uendith it": *y* raised before *uendith*.

Marks, not letters (as 005, 007):
- col 76 l. 31 — "Ie, Arglwyd, ! mynet": a "!" in the line; nothing missing (Red Book "Je argl6yd heb ef mynet").
- col 77 l. 8 — "rac ! guelet": the same mark; nothing missing.

Where Evans differs from the witness (Evans adopted):
- col 75 l. 36 — **"bei as caffwnn i wy oll"**: Evans *afcaff6n ni 6ý*; divided *caffwnn i* as the witness (same
  letters), the witness's * dropped. Red Book "pei as caffôn i oll ôwynt". NOTE FOR DRAFTER: *wy* 'them' resumes
  the infixed *-s*.
- col 78 l. 23 — **"mi a'y prynaf y genhyt"**: Evans *mi aý pzýnaf* (y, certain at zoom 4); the witness *a'e*. The
  infixed pronoun refers to the mouse (*llygoden*, f.) — *'y* is the usual WB spelling for 'her/it'.
- col 80 l. 36 — **"yn wreigyang geccaf a welsei neb"**: Evans *geccaf* (g, certain at zoom 10); witness and Red
  Book *deccaf*. Kept: a readable slip for *deccaf*. NOTE FOR DRAFTER. The witness's * before *a welsei* dropped
  (the Red Book has nothing there either).
- col 80 l. 31 — "rytha uy ngwreic im": Evans *uýng6zeic* (with n), as the witness; contrast col 79 l. 35 and
  col 80 l. 28 *uy gwreic*, *wy gwreic* (no n). Both kept as written.

## Forms kept for the drafter's notes
- *lledrith* (col 79 l. 9) but *lletrith* (col 80 l. 5): both as Evans (the Red Book has *lletrith* at both).
- *ymodi* (col 77 ll. 3, 32): Evans and witness; the Red Book has *teimlaw* at the first.
- *wy gwreic / uy gwreic / uy ngwreic* 'my wife' (three spellings).
- *bydyn* (col 81 l. 8): Evans and witness; Red Book *bydynt* — a slip for *bydynt* or a 3 pl. without -t.
- *kywein gueir* (col 81 l. 8): as Evans; Red Book *kywein geir*; sense of *kywein* uncertain (say so).
- *y geing* (col 81 l. 14; Red Book *geinc*), *Mabinogy* (Red Book *mabinogi*), *Mynweir a Mynord* (RB *mynnweir
  amynoad*).
- *doethwyf* 'I have come' (col 78 l. 21; RB *deuthum*); *eisswys* (RB *eissoes*); *En llawen* (col 78 l. 6).
- *a gehy* / *a geffy* (col 79 ll. 7, 10): both 'you will get'; Evans has *gehy* once.

## Blanks, gaps and words not supplied
None. No blanks in cols 75–81 within the part; the witness's two asterisks are not supplements the sense needs.

## Word division and punctuation (ours)
The witness's, with its quotation marks ‘ ’ → “ ”, one stray comma before a new speech corrected to a full stop
(col 78 l. 3, "e ymdeith.” “Na uynhaf"). *kyn no hynny* (Evans *kýnno*), *e ymdeith*, *e hun*, *e hunein*,
*yuelly*, *ar y seith meirch* (Evans *ar ýſeith*) read as *ar y seith meirch* 'on the seven horses' (witness), *Y herwa*,
*broch yghot*.

## For the drafter (summary)
Raised y/h/y; the two "!" marks; caffwnn i wy oll; a'y prynaf (not a'e); geccaf (slip for deccaf); lledrith/lletrith;
ymodi; three spellings of 'my wife'; bydyn; kywein gueir (uncertain); y geing, Mabinogy; doethwyf; gehy. No words
supplied.
